Name: Active Time (case granularity)
Explanation: Difference between the lead time and the idle time of a case.
Potential_use: Event log that contains lifecycle information for activity instances where the actual time that the case is active is of interest.
Required_attributes: $actinst$ – Event attribute: activity instance ; $case$ – Event attribute: case id ; $time$ – Event attribute: timestamp ; $type$ – Event attribute: lifecycle type
Assumptions: Maximizing active time is desirable.
Description_fp:
\(\mathit{LT(c)\) returns the Lead Time (time from case start to completion) of case \(c\).
\newline \(\mathit{IT(c)\) returns the Idle Time (total time spent waiting or idle) of case \(c\). \\

Name: Waiting Time (case granularity)
Explanation: Sum of elapsed time between the start event of an activity instance and the complete event of the activity instance that precedes it, for all activity instances in a case.
Potential_use: Event log in which the waiting time between every activity instance is of relevance.
Required_attributes: $actinst$ – Event attribute: activity instance ; $case$ – Event attribute: case id ; $time$ – Event attribute: timestamp ; $type$ – Event attribute: lifecycle type
Assumptions: Minimizing waiting time is desirable.
Description_fp:
\(\mathit{inst(c)\) returns the set of all activity instances in case \(c\).
\newline \(\mathit{WT(i)\) returns the waiting time of activity instance \(i\). \\
references_formatted: Walsh (1996); Fogarty (1992); van den Ingh (2016); Chimhamhiwa et al. (2009); Lehnert et al. (2014); Pourshahid et al. (2009); Rinaldi et al. (2015)

Name: Waiting Time (activity instance granularity)
Explanation: Elapsed time between the start event of an activity instance and the complete event of the activity instance that precedes it.
Potential_use: Event log in which the time spent between every activity instance is of relevance.
Required_attributes: $actinst$ – Event attribute: activity instance ; $case$ – Event attribute: case id ; $time$ – Event attribute: timestamp ; $type$ – Event attribute: lifecycle type
Assumptions: Minimizing waiting time is desirable.
Description_fp:
\(\mathit{stime(i)\) returns the start timestamp of activity instance \(i\).
\newline \(\mathit{ctime(x)\) returns the completion timestamp of activity instance \(x\).
\newline \(\mathit{prev(i)\) returns the set of preceding activity instances to instance \(i\). \\
references_formatted: Walsh (1996); Fogarty (1992); van den Ingh (2016); Chimhamhiwa et al. (2009); Lehnert et al. (2014); Pourshahid et al. (2009); Rinaldi et al. (2015)

Name: Waiting Time from activity A to activity B (case granularity)
Explanation: Sum of elapsed time between the start event of an activity instance and the complete event of the activity instance that precedes it, for all activity instances in a case that occur between the earliest instantiation of a specific activity and the earliest instantiation of another specific activity that occurs after the former one, including both.
Potential_use: Event log in which the time spent between every activity instance of a specific subprocess is of relevance.
Required_attributes: $act$ – Event attribute: activity ; $actinst$ – Event attribute: activity instance ; $case$ – Event attribute: case id ; $time$ – Event attribute: timestamp ; $type$ – Event attribute: lifecycle type
Extra_input: $a$ – the first specific activity ; $b$ – the second specific activity
Assumptions: Minimizing waiting time is desirable.
Description_fp:
\(\mathit{wt\) returns the waiting time between activity instance \(x\) and activity instance \(y\).
\newline \(\mathit{fi\mathit{^{s\) returns the set of first started instances of activity \(\mathit{a\) in case \(c\).
\newline \(\mathit{fi\) returns the set of first instances of activity \(\mathit{b\) that occur after the first instance of \(\mathit{a\) in case \(c\). \\

Name: Warehousing Cost (case granularity)
Explanation: Warehousing cost associated with all activity instances of a case.
Potential_use: Process where the cost of warehousing is relevant.
Required_attributes: $case$ – Event attribute: case id ; $warec$ – Case attribute: warehousing cost
Assumptions: Minimizing warehousing cost is desirable.
Description_fp: \(#^{}_{\mathit{warec}\) returns the warehousing cost associated with case \(c\). \\

Name: Warehousing Cost (group of cases granularity)
Explanation: Warehousing cost associated with all activity instances of a group of cases.
Potential_use: Process where the cost of warehousing is relevant.
Required_attributes: $case$ – Event attribute: case id ; $warec$ – Case attribute: warehousing cost
Assumptions: Minimizing warehousing cost is desirable.
Description_fp: \(\mathit{WareC(c)\) returns the warehousing cost for case \(c\). \\
